description: This Java source file defines the AcknowledgementAdapter class, which implements the Adapter interface for mapping between Acknowledgement objects and Adaptable representations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It includes methods for converting acknowledgements to and from adaptable protocol messages, handling topic path creation, header translation, and payload construction.

classes.name: AcknowledgementAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that converts between Acknowledgement objects and Adaptable protocol messages, handling topic paths, headers, and payload construction.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Factory method to obtain an instance of AcknowledgementAdapter with a given HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: fromAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Adaptable object into an Acknowledgement instance.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts an Acknowledgement object into an Adaptable for protocol messaging.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns the set of TopicPath.Groups this adapter handles (THINGS).

methods.name: getChannels
methods.description: Returns the set of channels (TWIN, LIVE) this adapter supports.

methods.name: getCriteria
methods.description: Returns the criteria (ACKS) for topic path filtering.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns an empty set as no specific actions are associated.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is used for responses.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates that a subject is required in topic paths.
